Quote post with a video game that takes you back to your childhood. --- I had to pick this one didn't I? But various early Final Fantasies could've easily taken this spot.
link card: Star Fox Arwing; quotes @srkah.bsky.social: Quote post with a video game that takes you back to your childhood. --- Still great to this day.
items.text: Star Fox and the early Final Fantasies both feel like a whole era. The music alone from those games brings it all back.

items.author: sandwichfrank.northsky.social
items.context: Games don’t really /need/ to look better than PlayStation 2, right? Maybe Wii? I know that’s a severe old man opinion but if you hired the best writers and artists the hardware limitations kinda don’t matter, right?
items.text: A strong art style ages far better than raw detail, and that goes for PC classics from that era too. Plenty of them still look great today.
